g.text: DF: time / precision with exploration and fixed confirmation kept distinct
H4 DF10 / H6 DF19 (weighted completion), linear1 Å/STO-3G; original T and 5 precisions; P=0; full Hadamard RZ, opt1/seed17. ALL is the original saved selection scope.
40 exploration cells; the fixed comparison CSV contains 33 PR-vs-PF confirmation records. No confirmation is imputed for the other cells; no pooling or new success rate.
Confirmation CSV stores SE of the comparison difference, not separate-side SE. Hollow means therefore have no invented individual error bars. Old 33/40, G01 expansion and
